description: Search articles and content on the Free Discovery plan. Returns metadata only (no full article body). Each call increments the monthly Free Discovery search quota (100 queries/month).

cursor.description: Opaque pagination cursor from a previous response next_cursor. Continues within the top-100 candidate window.

filters.description: Optional metadata filters to narrow search results. Available fields: category (string), categories (array), language (string), sentiment (string), media_type (string), has_image/has_video/has_audio (boolean), length_words/length_chars/duration_seconds (number), publish_date_ts (number timestamp), keywords (array), entities (array). Operators: $eq (equals), $ne (not equals), $gt/$gte/$lt/$lte (numeric), $in/$nin (array match), $exists (field presence), $and/$or (logical). Examples: {"category": "sports"}, {"has_video": true}, {"$and":[{"publish_date_ts":{"$gte":1704067200}}]}, {"$and":[{"categories": {"$in": ["sports", "news"]}}]}, {"$and": [{"category": "sports"}, {"has_image": true}]}. Filters evaluated during vector search.

limit.description: Maximum number of articles to return. Default: 10. Results are ordered by similarity score (highest first)

publishers.description: Optional array of lowercase publisher identifiers to narrow the search (e.g. adweek, billboard). Omit to search all publishers available on Free Discovery.

query.description: Semantic search query to find relevant articles. Supports natural language queries (e.g., 'Taylor Swift', 'NFL playoffs', 'climate change policy')

query_vector.description: Optional precomputed embedding vector. If provided, retrieval uses this vector directly instead of generating one from query.

recent.description: Recent mode: {since_ts: epoch seconds, take: int} or {days_back: int, take: int}. If both are provided, since_ts takes precedence.

threshold.description: Similarity score threshold (0.0-1.0). Only returns articles with similarity scores above this value. Lower values = stricter matching. Default: 1.0 (returns all matches)

name: search
title: Search articles (discovery)
